hero.title: Calibration, repairs and sales of precision measuring instruments
hero.summary: JIE is a trusted partner providing industrial measuring instruments, calibration, sales and repair services, with a commitment to accurate results and reliable support for measurement needs.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Calibration, on-site calibration, repairs and tool-error adjustment, and supply of spare parts and instruments.

products.title: Products
products.intro: Measuring instruments and spares from leading brands, with calibration and repair support for all major brands of measuring instruments.

disciplines.title: Calibration disciplines
disciplines.intro: Precise, reliable and traceable calibration for a wide range of instruments and equipment, helping industries, institutions and hospitals meet quality, safety and regulatory requirements.

onSite.title: On-site calibration at your facility
onSite.summary: JIE has developed on-site calibration facilities for selected instruments and equipment. Calibration is performed at your facility, saving time and travel cost, and refers to BIS and ISO standards.

process.title: How calibration works
process.intro: Four steps from receipt to return, with documentation for industry, regulatory and audit requirements.

why.title: Why choose JIE
why.intro: A calibration partner for measurement needs across manufacturing, service, medical and civil customers.

items.title: Experienced and skilled team
items.description: Calibration and repair work is carried out by an experienced and skilled team.

items.title: State-of-the-art calibration facility
items.description: Calibration is carried out at a state-of-the-art calibration facility in Belgaum.

items.title: Prompt and cost-effective service
items.description: Simple and cost-effective pricing, with quick service and minimal downtime.

items.title: Traceable to National / International Standards
items.description: Certification is maintained and updated, traceable to National / International Standards.

clients.title: Trusted by leading industries
clients.intro: A selection of the customers named by JIE across cement, hydraulics, automotive, power, medical, government and logistics work.

industries.title: Industries we serve
industries.intro: Instruments and equipment for manufacturing, service, medical and civil customers.

items.title: Cement and construction
items.description: Compressive strength of cubes, aggregate and building material testing, and force measuring machines.

items.title: Automotive and engineering
items.description: Measuring instruments, gauges and test equipment for manufacturing and engineering customers.

items.title: Power and railways
items.description: Calibration for thermal power and railway customers.

items.title: Medical and healthcare
items.description: Bio-medical equipment calibration for hospitals and medical institutes.

items.title: Government and forensic
items.description: Calibration for government projects and regional forensic science laboratories.

locations.title: Calibration lab and branch office
locations.intro: The calibration lab is in Udyambag, Belgaum, with a branch office in Hubli.
